headword: {救命講習|きゅうめいこうしゅう}
reading: きゅうめいこうしゅう

definitions.explanation: A short training course, often run by the fire department, that teaches emergency first aid such as CPR and the use of an AED. Open to the general public.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{救命講習|きゅうめいこうしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I took a lifesaving course at my company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{消防署|しょうぼうしょ}→消防署：06454_shoubousho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{救命講習|きゅうめいこうしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いている→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The fire station holds lifesaving courses.

notes:
A course teaching emergency first aid, most often run by the local ⟦{消防署|しょうぼうしょ}→消防署：06454_shoubousho⟧ (fire station). Completing certain courses earns a {修了証|しゅうりょうしょう} (certificate).
